signIn.title: Sign in to the admin console
signIn.expired: That sign-in took too long. Sign in again.
signIn.failed: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again.

user.reasonHelp: Shown in the audit log. The launcher locks at its next check (within an hour).
user.revokeBody: That launcher is signed out at its next request.
user.lastAdmin: You can't remove the last admin.
user.self: You can't do that to your own account.

settings.title: Settings
settings.graceHelp: How long a launcher may run without reaching the API (1–30).

plans.title: Plans
plans.name: Name
plans.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; fixed after creation.
plans.archivedHelp: Archived plans keep the people on them but can no longer be bought or granted.
plans.priceHelp: Leave empty for no price. The amount is read from Stripe when you save.

reasons.interval: This Stripe price is not a {{interval}} recurring price.
reasons.inactive: This Stripe price is not active.
reasons.unknownPrice: Stripe has no price with this id.
reasons.currency: Both prices must be in the same currency.
reasons.billingOff: No billing provider is configured, so price ids can't be checked.
reasons.priceTaken: This price is already on another plan.
reasons.defaultPlan: The Default plan can't be archived.

plans.whyDevices: Devices must be a whole number from 1 to 20.
plans.whySlug: The slug uses 2–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

scopes.title: Catalog scopes
scopes.intro: Plans pick scopes; each catalog item belongs to one.
scopes.name: Name

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.expiresHelp: Empty: until revoked. Access ends at the end of that day (UTC).
subscription.noteHelp: Why, for the audit log (up to 500 characters).
subscription.revokeBody: The launcher locks at its next check (within an hour).

reasons.subscribed: This user pays through Stripe — they must cancel first.

subscription.noPlans: No plan can be granted: every plan is archived.
subscription.plansFailed: Plans couldn't be loaded, so nothing can be granted. Reload the page.

deleteUser.title: Delete {{email}}?
deleteUser.body: The account, its devices and subscriptions are deleted. A Stripe subscription is cancelled now, with no automatic refund (refund by hand in Stripe if needed). Audit entries stay, without the email.

reasons.admin: Admins must be demoted before their account can be deleted.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.badSlug: Lowercase letters and numbers, separated by single dashes (60 at most).

fields.slugHelp: Fixed once created; names the game's folder on players' PCs.
fields.title: Title
fields.yearRange: A year from 1950 to 2100, or empty.

files.title: Files
files.name: File
files.uploadHelp: Up to 4 GB per file. A file with the same name replaces the old one; on a published item players get an update.
files.badName: “{{name}}” can’t be used as a file name.
files.badExtension: “{{name}}” can’t be used: a ROM or disc for {{system}} must end in {{extensions}}.
files.replaceBody: The item is published: its version goes up and players see Update available.
files.removeBodyPublished: The item is published: its version goes up and players see Update available.

art.title: Art
art.help: Images or videos, up to 50 MB each. A new upload replaces the old one.

license.territoriesHelp: Country codes separated by commas (BR, US). Empty: worldwide.
license.datesHelp: Optional. Dates are UTC: the license starts and ends at the start of that day. An expired license unpublishes the item.
license.replaceNote: Saving replaces the license: its evidence and verification start over.
license.unpublishWarning: Saving a new license unpublishes this item until the new license is verified.
license.evidenceHelp: The permission document: PDF, PNG, JPEG, text or email file, up to 20 MB.
license.evidenceType: Evidence must be a PDF, PNG, JPEG, text or email file.

publish.onLapseHelp: Unpublished, license expired, or no longer in a player's plan. Pick one: there is no default.
publish.keepHelp: Installed copies stay playable, marked “No longer in the catalog”.
publish.removeHelp: Installed copies are deleted from players' PCs, with a notice.
publish.starterHelp: Shown first to new players whose plan includes it.
publish.unpublishBody: Players can't install it any more; installed copies follow its “When it leaves the catalog” choice.

blockers.onLapse: Pick what happens when it leaves the catalog
blockers.files: Add a ROM or disc file

errors.lastFile: A published item needs at least one ROM or disc file.
errors.type: Art must be an image or a video.
errors.verified: The license is verified: save a new license to change its evidence.
errors.blocked: The item isn't ready to publish yet.
errors.checksum: The upload was damaged on the way: try again.
errors.notUploaded: The upload didn't finish: try again.
